Hero_Desc_Orr:
A versatile inventor from Monatium who occasionally reveals an eccentric side.
She loses herself in daydreams at every opportunity, but whenever an idea strikes, she cannot rest until she has built it herself.
Despite her difficult circumstances, she never gives up and always preserves her own sense of romance.
Album_Hate_Orr: An empty materials warehouse, an empty head with no ideas
Album_Hobby_Orr: Taking apart things Elena made, cooking
Album_Wish_Orr: To exercise her talents freely without worrying about materials or money
Album_Orr1: Orr kept pacing up and down Monatium Avenue with a vacant expression. When I called to her, she startled so badly that she fell over. I asked what she had been doing to become so distracted. She said she had seen exhausted citizens shuffling to work that morning and wondered whether she could build a road that carried them automatically, without any walking. Does she mean... some kind of moving walkway?
Album_Orr2: While we were chatting about everyday matters in the banquet hall, Orr suddenly sketched something and pushed it in front of me. When I asked what it was, she said it was a blueprint for a machine that dusts off one's hair, hastily inspired by the ash on my head. Could I not simply brush it away by hand? Does this truly require a machine?!
Album_Orr3: While walking through the Fairy Forest, I followed the sound of voices and found Bigwood striking elaborate poses while Orr drew him. She said that staying in her workshop had become stifling, so she came out to draw for the first time in ages and happened to meet Bigwood... Then she offered to draw me too if I stood beside him and posed. I refused immediately.
Album_Orr4: I met Orr at the smithy when I went to visit Bana after a long absence. She said she had already spent several days there learning smithing from Bana, whose technique became more astonishing the more she observed it. Bana praised Orr in return, saying her blueprints were so precise and detailed that they greatly reduced the working time. They looked like a perfect team, and for once, the sight warmed my heart.
Album_Orr5: Orr told me that the Statue of Elena the Just in Monatium and Elena's portrait in City Hall were both her work. I had heard she was artistically gifted, but I never imagined she was that good! Amazed by her talent, I asked whether Elena knew. Orr said she probably did not. When Amelia took the statue and portrait, she apparently insisted an anonymous donation was cooler and promised to report them as gifts from a talented citizen of Monatium. Orr wore a bitter expression as she looked at Elena's portrait in City Hall.
Album_Orr6: Orr said she was unexpectedly close with Festa. They seemed to have nothing in common, so I asked how they became friends. Inspired by Festa's guitar playing, Orr had built a matching drum shaped like a cart. When pulled along, drumsticks connected to the wheels strike the drum and play it automatically... They became friends after performing together on Monatium Avenue and being hauled away by the suppression squad. What is this, a friendship forged in jail...?
Album_Orr7: Orr's workshop was packed with inventions she had made. Many were fascinating, and many others seemed genuinely useful. When I said it was a shame to keep them confined to the workshop, she replied that Elena would neither approve her patent applications nor accept her product registrations, leaving her no choice. I offered to speak to Elena for her, but Orr firmly refused and said she wanted Monatium to recognize her solely through her own ability, without anyone's help. The wistfulness in her voice made it all the more painful.
LoveHero_Orr: Hmm? Interested in my inventions? Look as much as you like!
LoveHeroCancel_Orr: Hmph. You will return the inventions you borrowed, right?
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Hate1: The moment she smelled the creme brulee before her, she leaped up and tried to flee. She says that when she smells gunpowder during an invention, something usually explodes, so running away has become a habit.
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Hate2: She pushed the plate far away, saying that melted or dripping ice cream could enter a mechanism and break it. Apparently, next time she will bring a machine that lets her eat it without spilling.
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like1: Orr seems to consider the hot iced Americano one of Monatium's finest inventions. She calls it a remarkable invention that turned a reversal of perspective into reality.
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like2: After peering into the hollow center of the Air Cutlet, Orr's eyes lit up and she sprang from her seat. She says an incredible idea came to her... from looking at that?
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like3: Orr's eyes grew round after tasting the chewy rice cakes in the soup. Her only complaint was that the heat kept her from eating them quickly.
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like4: Upon seeing the buche de Noel, Orr raised her thumb and praised its exceptional sense of aesthetics. She seems to think the flavor is excellent too.
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like5: She said it would be perfect to eat while working and asked whether I could pack a little for her, so I did. Surely she does not plan to use it as a substitute for meals?
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like6: She was delighted to find ingredients inside the chewy rice cake. She thanked me and left, saying it had helped inspire an idea for an invention she was developing.
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like7: After tasting the Almond Rocher, Orr immediately began filling her notebook. When I asked what she was writing, she said it was a blueprint for a machine that could mass-produce Almond Rochers.
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like8: She seems quite fond of the tart flavor. After finishing it, she tried to scrape the bowl clean, so I promised to make it again next time.
Food_ChefNote_Orr_Like9: She was fascinated by the candies, each with its own flavor and shape. She seemed to want to take them away for analysis, but is simply eating them not an option?

LoveLetter_Orr:
Master! Thank you for always taking an interest in my unimpressive inventions and even holding an exhibition for them! Looking back now, I think I might have given up inventing if not for you. I wanted to repay you for always supporting me, so I prepared a small gift! I hope you like it!

Is there anything you need lately? If something in your daily life or work inconveniences you, I will try making a useful invention! Just as you always support me, I will support you too! Thank you, Master~!
LoveCall_Orr:
Hello, Master. It is Orr.
For some strange reason, I have been thinking of you often lately, so I decided to call.
You have left many encouraging messages on my recorder for me, but this is my first time leaving words like these for you, so it is a little embarrassing...
I am always cheering for you with all my heart.
Ahem. First, I will leave you a message of encouragement!
Master, you are the best! You are truly amazing! Come on, you can do it!

Did that record properly?
I owe you so much, Master, and I am always grateful.
That is why I have been wondering how I could ever repay it all.
Is there anything you need?
I am rather good at inventing, and fairly handy with repairs too!
So whenever you need something or have anything to repair, contact me without hesitation.
I would gladly help with that much.
After all, you understand me better than anyone, Master!
